title: Normal 1, scRNAseq
characteristics_ch1: cell type: peripheral blood mononuclear cell
growth_protocol_ch1: Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMCs) in the blood samples were obtained from normal individuals and PD patients.
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were purified by Ficoll gradient separation, according to the instructions of the manufacturer (Ficoll–PaqueTM Plus, GE Healthcare, Sweden). In short, 3 mL of Ficoll-Paque gradient was pipetted into two 15-ml centrifuge tubes. The blood was diluted with a ratio 1:1 in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) and carefully layered over the Ficoll-Paque gradient. The tubes were centrifuged for 30 min at 400 × g. The cell interface layer was harvested carefully (8 ml/tube), and the cells were washed twice in PBS (for 10 min at 100 × g). PBMCs were resuspended in 1 mL complete culture medium (DMEM medium supplemented with 10 % newborn calf serum, 1 % PS).
RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols
data_processing: The demultiplexing, barcoded processing, gene counting and aggregation were made using the Cell Ranger software v2.2.0 (https://support.10xgenomics.com/single-cell-gene-expression/software/pipelines/latest/what-is-cell-ranger)
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values files and matrix files

metadata.source_identity_policy: Six whole-PBMC specimens from six primary-publication participants: two controls, two early PD and two late PD. Expanded flow-cytometry/PCR and postmortem cohorts are not additional scRNA samples.
metadata.source_coverage_policy: Whole density-gradient PBMC; source title and primary methods agree. Original deposited RNA counts used without selecting an author cell type.
metadata.source_preservation_policy: Primary methods report immediate cryopreservation after PBMC isolation; GEO protocol describes suspension in culture medium. Do not infer ex-vivo stimulation or duration.
metadata.source_missingness_policy: Individual demographics, scores, medications and dates have no verified per-GSM join here. Primary supplementary Table1 remains a metadata-enrichment lead; cohort-level ranges are not individual ages or dates. Stable medication is cohort context, not untreated status.
metadata.source_count_policy: Nonnegative integer native RNA triplets required. No log inverse, Harmony coordinates or source-normalized matrix used as counts.
metadata.split_assignment: unassigned; study-scoped donor kept intact; cross-study identity unresolved
